study.question: Does buy-only auxiliary context ownership specifically permit auxiliary tower capacity reduction, or is the apparent rescue explained by a policy main effect unrelated to width?
study.hypothesis: Observed limitation: full/all AUC0.66714101695 drops to0.66574367807 on auxiliary narrowing with all context gradients attached. Narrow buy-only recovers to0.66716691821, whereas narrow cart-only/fav-only score0.66529994819/0.66456701403. Full versus narrow with all auxiliary context gradients blocked gave identical click AUC0.66676042934, below the best; indiscriminate blocking is not a validated improvement. Hypothesis: the effect of auxiliary capacity on shared context updates depends on which task supplies them, so removing cart/fav context gradients may attenuate the narrowing penalty. Missing full-width buy-only control prevents attributing the current result to conditional capacity utility. This is a local factorial attribution study, with no new architecture or verified originality claim.

nearest_work.difference: Inherit the entire standalone task-subset model. Add the missing full-width buy cell and contemporaneous full/all and small/all endpoints; vary only constructor width and context-task subset. The policy itself is inherited, not newly invented.

Read archived primary text including lines315-336 for Dice training/testing moments and local-activation description. Inherit DIN local activation and Dice through the joint parent. This study concerns auxiliary head capacity and backward context ownership; it is not an exact DIN reproduction.

Pinned primary benchmark implementation inspected at lines123-219: categorical/sequence/task hubs exchange forward representations. Current study retains the local joint forward representation and changes only head size/context-gradient ownership, without adopting hubs. Original INFNet paper remains unaudited and benchmark source does not prove equivalence to it.

study.proposed_difference: No forward-method rewrite. Submit four standalone modules forming width{128,112} x context-owner{cart/fav/buy,buy}. Keep auxiliary second layer64 and click tower128/64. Only CONFIG and matching constructor defaults differ. Expected narrow savings22368 parameters (7.10% dense;0.0697% total); no measured speedup is assumed. Preserve g2-r0038 narrow buy source byte-for-byte as one endpoint. Full/all and small/all add a source-equivalent all-task gate versus their historical implementations and require host bridge checks.
predictions: At fixed width and fixed parameter/buffer state, changing context owners preserves all forward probabilities and Dice buffer updates; only cart/fav upstream context derivatives change. These assertions require host tensor/gradient checks, not syntax tests.

Narrow all repeats its earlier AUC loss while narrow buy preserves AUC relative to full buy and contemporaneous full all. The interaction contrast I is positive; freeze I>=0.0002 as exploratory support, not a significance test.

Frozen utility gate: narrow buy must score no more than0.0002 below each of contemporaneous full/all, full/buy and repeated narrow/buy incumbent historical AUC0.6671669182126774. Required historical floor is0.6669669182126774. Report original joint reference AUC0.666753547526167 and DIN0.6555440824200336 separately; beating a weaker reference does not pass this gate.

Frozen cost gate: capacity removal reduces host-confirmed total/dense parameters, lowers model-only batch p50 by at least1% versus contemporaneous full/buy and full/all, does not worsen p95 by more than1%, and does not worsen total inference seconds or training seconds by more than3%. Use fixed host batch8192, hardware/precision/data order; report inference throughput, wall/GPU cost, examples and memory if the host supplies them. Do not substitute MAC estimates for measured prediction cost.

All task AUC/Logloss and history slices with sample/positive/negative counts are reported when host provides them. Buy-only narrow previously changed p50 from15.4168 to15.3874ms (about0.19%); this does not pass the1% cost gate. Same-seed reruns estimate reproducibility/timing noise and are not independent mechanism replications.
falsifiers: AUC drop exceeding0.0002 versus any named quality comparator rejects the candidate utility claim, even if it beats DIN or the original joint model.
No measured speed reduction meeting the frozen cost gate rejects practical prediction-cost utility even if parameter savings and AUC preservation hold.
I<0.0002 or similar narrowing penalties at both ownership policies fails to support ownership-dependent capacity rescue; a buy-only main effect may remain.

Endpoint bridge failures or unexpected gradient/buffer/mask changes are execution/integrity problems, not scientific counterevidence. Retain failed receipts and charged cost before a discriminating correction.
One favorable factorial result supports a provisional local interaction, not broad negative-transfer, necessity, significance, novelty, or production claims.
